features.name: greek__delta_net
features.description: Estimated net delta exposure across the entire option chain, OI-weighted with calls positive and puts negative.

features.name: greek__gamma_net
features.description: Estimated net gamma exposure aggregated and OI-weighted across the chain.

features.name: greek__vega_net
features.description: Estimated net vega exposure to implied volatility changes.

features.name: greek__theta_net
features.description: Estimated net theta exposure representing aggregate time decay pressure.

features.name: greek__delta_flow
features.description: Change in greek__delta_net versus the previous snapshot.

features.name: greek__gamma_flow
features.description: Change in greek__gamma_net versus the previous snapshot.

features.name: greek__implied_vol_surface_flag
features.description: Ternary indicator of IV surface movement: +1 rising, 0 stable, -1 falling.

features.name: greek__vanna_net
features.description: Proxy estimate of net vanna exposure (delta sensitivity to IV) aggregated across the chain.

features.name: greek__charm_net
features.description: Proxy estimate of net charm exposure capturing delta decay with time.

features.name: greek__skew_slope
features.description: Local slope of implied volatility skew around at-the-money strikes.

features.name: greek__vol_of_vol_proxy
features.description: Proxy metric for volatility-of-volatility derived from implied volatility dispersion.

features.name: greek__gamma_shock_indicator
features.description: Boolean flag for abnormally large gamma_flow relative to recent baseline.

features.name: greek__sticky_delta_indicator
features.description: Continuous proxy (0–1) for sticky-delta behavior in implied volatility.

features.name: greek__delta_hedge_pressure
features.description: Estimated delta hedging notional required for a 1% underlying move.

features.name: greek__gamma_per_notional
features.description: Gamma exposure normalized by total option notional outstanding.
